data.subject: Public-record research for Peapod Lane
data.body:
Hi,

Peapod Lane Capital's most recent 13F (period June 30, 2026) shows positions in STHO, ALCO, and LMNR.

On September 23, 2026, six City of Asbury Park, NJ, council agenda items mentioned the Waterfront Redevelopment Area, Block 3801, or 320 Asbury Avenue (entitlement) (https://asburyparknj.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=5735,plainText=false).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records, including permits, agendas, call reports, and filings, with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
